get.description:
Retrieve the organization and workspaces a personal access token can see.

No workspace_id path param required - the response is bound to the token's own
organization_id/workspace_ids claims. Bearer sessions authenticate fine but get a 404
from the service, since they carry no equivalent single scoped claim to bind to.

Retrieve the organization that owns ``workspace_id``, with its workspaces.

``workspace_id`` identifies the caller's current workspace; the response describes the whole
organization, not just that workspace. Archived workspaces are excluded unless
``include_archived`` is true.

post.description:
Create a new workspace in the organization that owns ``workspace_id``.

The new workspace gets an "All Users" group, the calling user as an organization admin, and
every other org admin added automatically. It inherits the source workspace's data
processing region, and any enterprise LLM credentials are copied over.

Archive a workspace in the caller's organization.

This is a soft delete: the workspace is marked archived and inactive, and its users are
reassigned to another workspace in the organization. ``confirmation_name`` must match the
target workspace's name, and you cannot archive the workspace you are currently in.

get.description:
List the user attribute values set on a group.

These apply to every member of the group. When a member is in several groups that set the
same attribute, the group with the highest ``user_attribute_precedence`` wins.

post.description:
Set a user attribute value on a group.

``user_attribute_definition_id`` must reference an existing definition in the workspace. A
group can only set each definition once; a second value for the same definition returns
409 — patch the existing value instead.

delete.description:
Remove a user attribute value from a group.

The definition itself is untouched — only this group's value for it is deleted.

patch.description:
Update the value of a user attribute already set on a group.

Only ``value`` is mutable; to point at a different definition, delete this value and
create a new one.

get.description:
List every group in the workspace, including the built-in "All Users" group.

Each group carries its member ids and its ``user_attribute_precedence``. A warning is
returned when two groups in the workspace share a precedence value, since the winning
user attribute is then undefined.

post.description:
Create a group in the workspace.

``user_attribute_precedence`` must be greater than 0 and decides which group's value wins
when a member belongs to several groups that set the same user attribute. A warning is
returned when the new group duplicates an existing precedence value.

get.description:
Retrieve a single group in the workspace by id.

Returns 404 if no group with that id exists in the workspace.

patch.description:
Update a group's name, members, or user attribute precedence.

The built-in "All Users" group cannot be updated; its membership always tracks the
workspace roster.

delete.description:
Delete a group and the user attributes attached to it.

Members are not deleted, only their membership. The built-in "All Users" group cannot be
deleted.

get.description:
List the user attribute values that apply to a workspace member.

Includes values inherited from the member's groups as well as values set directly on the
member. ``is_overridden`` marks a group-inherited value that a higher-precedence value has
superseded, so the effective set is the entries where it is false.

post.description:
Set a user attribute value directly on a workspace member.

A value set here takes precedence over any value the member inherits from a group. Each
member can only set a given definition once; a duplicate returns 409 — patch the existing
value instead.

delete.description:
Remove a user attribute value set directly on a workspace member.

Only values set on the member can be deleted here; group-inherited values are managed on
the group. Once removed, any group value for that definition applies again.

patch.description:
Update the value of a user attribute set directly on a workspace member.

Only ``value`` is mutable; to point at a different definition, delete this value and
create a new one.

get.description:
List the user attribute definitions in the workspace.

A definition declares the ``name``, ``label``, and ``data_type`` of an attribute. The
per-member and per-group endpoints then assign values against these definitions.

post.description:
Create a user attribute definition in the workspace.

``name`` must be unique within the workspace; a duplicate returns 409. The ``data_type``
is fixed at creation time and cannot be changed afterwards.

delete.description:
Delete a user attribute definition and every value assigned against it.

This removes the attribute from all members and groups in the workspace.

patch.description:
Update a user attribute definition's label.

Only ``label`` is mutable — ``name`` and ``data_type`` are fixed once created, because
assigned values and data model references depend on them.
